/* --- List Ordered Large Blue is replacing Ordered Square Blue List - once all references are gone, remove styles for square list--- */
.list-ordered-square-blue, .list-ordered-large-blue {
/*counter-reset: li;*/
/* This should allow for nested lists */
counter-reset: section;
margin: 30px 0 20px 0;
color: #666;
}

.list-ordered-square-blue > li, .list-ordered-large-blue > li {
position: relative;
display: block;
*display: block;
*zoom: 1;
margin-bottom: 30px;
padding-left: 55px;
counter-increment: section;
line-height:1.5em;
}

.list-ordered-square-blue > li:before, .list-ordered-large-blue > li:before {
position: absolute;
left: 0;
color: #00a9e0;
padding: 0px;
margin: -5px 15px 0 -5px;
font-size: 33px;
font-weight: bold;
text-align: right;
width: 40px;
/*content: counter(li);
counter-increment: li;*/
/* This should make it possible to use nested lists */
content: counter(section);
}


/* --- Basic Ordered list -- */

.list-ordered-basic li {
padding:0 0 15px 0;
}


/* --- Simple Ordered list -- */

.list-ordered-simple > li::before {
    color: #00a9e0;
    content: counter(section, decimal);
    font-size: 1em;
    font-weight: bold;
    left: 0;
    line-height: 22px;
    margin: 0 15px 0 0;
    position: absolute;
    text-align: right;
    width: 10px;
}

.list-ordered-simple > li {
    counter-increment: section;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding-left: 25px;
    position: relative;
}

.list-ordered-simple {
margin: 20px 0 20px 10px;
}

min-height: 170px !important;

/*------------------------------- Table Styles ------------------------------ */

table.left-aligned th {
  background-color: #eee;
font-weight: bold;
padding: 10px;
}

table.left-aligned td {

text-align: left;
padding: 5px;
padding-right: 2em;
}

table.left-aligned tr {
border-bottom: 1px solid #E7E7E8;
line-height: 1.5em;
}

table.left-aligned tbody tr:last-of-type {
border-top: 3px solid #34B9DC;
border-bottom: 0 none;
}


/* -------------------------------- Stacked Table Styles ---------------------------------- */


table.table-stacked {
	width: 100%;
	border-collapse: collapse;
}

table.table-stacked th, table.table-stacked td {
	padding: 15px;
}

table.table-stacked tr {
	border: none;
	border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
}

table.table-stacked thead tr:nth-of-type(1) {
	font-weight: normal;
	padding-right: 30px;
	border: none;
	border-bottom: 3px solid #35a9c6;
}

table.table-stacked th {
	font-weight: normal;
}

table.table-stacked td:nth-of-type(1) {
	font-weight: 500;
	padding-right: 30px;
}

table.table-stacked tr:nth:last-of-type(1) {
 padding-bottom:30px;
}

.table-caption {
	text-align: left;
	margin: 8px 0;
	padding: 20px 8px 30px 8px;
	font-size: 14px;
	line-height: 1.25em;
	caption-side: bottom;
}
table.table-stacked td {
	color: #666666;
}
 


@media only screen and (max-width:989px), (min-device-width:990px) and (max-device-width: 1024px) {
/* Force table to not be like tables anymore */


table.table-stacked, table.table-stacked thead, table.table-stacked tbody, table.table-stacked th, table.table-stacked td, table.table-stacked tr {
	display: block;
}

table.table-stacked tr:nth-of-type(even) {
	background: transparent;
}

table.table-stacked tr {
	border: none;
}



/* Hide table headers (but not display: none;, for accessibility) */

table.table-stacked thead tr {
	position: absolute;
	top: -9999px;
	left: -9999px;
}

table.table-stacked td:nth-of-type(1) {
	padding-right: 30px;
	border: none;
}

table.table-stacked td:nth-last-of-type(1) {
	border-bottom: none;
	padding-bottom: 50px;
}

caption.table-caption {
	caption-side: bottom;
	display: block;
}

table.table-stacked:nth-column(1) {
width: 50%;
}

table.table-stacked td {
	/* Behave  like a "row" */
	border: none;
	border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
	position: relative;
	padding-left: 75%;
}

table.table-stacked td:before {
	/* Now like a table header */
	position: absolute;
	/* Top/left values mimic padding */
	left: 6px;
	width: 50%;
	padding-right: 10px;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
}
}



/*------------------------------- Photo Gallery Widget ------------------------------ */
@media (max-width:1025px) { /* tablet, landscape iPad, lo-res laptops ands desktops */

}

#sb-nav-next {
  background-image: url(http://www.lambtoncollege.ca/uploadedImages/LambtonCollege/Template_Assets/Images/next-arrows-medium.png) !important;
}


}
